items.title: Customer access and maintenance — synthetic review exercise

sources.content: Customer management supports administrators, viewers and editors. Authorization behavior must be verified by role.

Viewers opening /customers/42/delete directly must see Access denied and the customer must remain. Admins can create a customer named Ada and see Ada in the customer list. Editors can change a customer phone number and the new number must persist after reload. CSV export permissions are awaiting product clarification.
Tests must assert the acceptance outcome. A page loading or a passing test alone does not establish coverage. Similar tests with different roles or boundaries may be justified.
Implement viewer denial, admin creation and editor updates. Export permissions remain undecided.

criteria.text: A viewer navigating directly to /customers/42/delete sees Access denied; the customer remains undeleted.
An admin creates a customer named Ada and sees Ada in the customer list.
An editor changes a customer phone number and sees the new value persist after reload.
CSV export must follow the agreed role permissions, which have not yet been defined.
